units.source_text: 小姐送他的衣服，是一件贵族用的常礼服。

en.t: The garment the young lady sent him was a formal everyday robe for a nobleman.

units.source_text: 颜色是当时流行的红色，式样古陋，光彩全无，不堪入目。

en.t: Its color was the red then in fashion, but the style was old-fashioned and crude, without the least elegance, and painful to look at.

units.source_text: 里子的颜色和面子一样深红。

en.t: The lining was the same deep crimson as the outer fabric.

units.source_text: 从袖口、下襟缝拢来的地方可以看出，真是平凡拙劣的手工。

en.t: From the stitching at the sleeve openings and where the lower collar was joined, one could see that the workmanship was truly plain and clumsy.

units.source_text: 源氏公子兴味索然，便在那张展开的信纸的空白地方戏笔似的题一首诗。

en.t: Prince Genji lost all interest, and on a blank space of the unfolded letter he casually wrote a poem, almost as a playful scribble.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇从一旁窥看，但见随随便便地写着：

en.t: Taifu no Myobu peeked from the side and saw that he had written carelessly:
